_note: Owner-approved outlets beyond the AllSides-rated set, for a two-week trial. Each entry admits its outlet only from approved_on through trial_ends, ET days (lib/press-outlets.mjs). An outlet on this list carries no lean, never counts toward 'across the spectrum', and a Big Question press update still needs at least one AllSides-rated outlet. To end an outlet early, set status to "ended" and ended_on to its last day, and keep the entry: the press updates written while it ran are checked against the days it was on this list. To renew, add a new entry that starts after the old one's last day.
_criterion: One eligibility test, applied to every candidate without regard to lean: (1) AllSides shows no current rating for the outlet in its latest archived capture (an outlet AllSides rates belongs in data/media-bias.json with its lean instead), and (2) the outlet published at least one dated item on a live Big Question's subject in the 90 days before 2026-09-26, read from the outlet's own page.
